schema_version: 1
owner: ms-go-auth
source_of_truth: docs/verification-storage.md
policy: internal/usecase/verification/service.go
port: internal/domain/verification.go
adapter: internal/infrastructure/persistence/tarantool/client.go
schema: scripts/tarantool
endpoint: identity-store:3301
protocol: authenticated_binary_named_call
functions:
  auth_verification_ready: ok_or_unavailable
  auth_verification:
    actions: [signup_start, signup_resend, signup_verify, signup_consume, email_start, email_verify, reset_start, reset_verify]
    transaction: box_atomic_validation_and_mutation
    errors: [not_found, expired, invalid_code, mismatch, code_conflict, unavailable]
runtime_privileges: [session, execute_auth_verification, execute_auth_verification_ready]
forbidden_runtime: [eval, arbitrary_call, schema_mutation, direct_space_reads]
code:
  format: four_decimal_digits
  generator: crypto_rand_fail_closed
  collision_attempts: 10
  delivery_adapter: absent
signup:
  normalization: lower_trim_email_and_trim_code
  receipt_binding: [canonical_non_nil_operation_uuid, normalized_email, length_framed_SHA256_email_code]
  frozen_fields: [original_password_hash, original_created_at_plus_hard_ttl]
  same_binding_recovery: allowed_before_frozen_expiry
  other_binding: rejected
  legacy_receipt_replay: forbidden
  replacement_under_active_receipt: rejected
  fallback: forbidden
email_change:
  lookup: atomic_unique_active_code_reservation
  consume: atomic_lookup_owner_validation_and_delete
  legacy_uuid_records: preserved_without_backfill
password_reset:
  consume: atomic_validate_and_delete
replacement: rejects_repeated_code_then_retries_crypto_allocation
cleanup:
  owner: single_lua_fiber
  interval_seconds: 60
  verification_scan: atomic_full_scan
  receipts: delete_at_frozen_expiry
  legacy_user_sandbox: retained_no_cleanup
modern_sandbox: separate_existing_business_and_storage_owner
